meta.name: Open Bracket
meta.tagline: The creator games where the crowd is in the bracket.
meta.locationDetail: Parade Ground and Colonels Row, Governors Island. Car-free. Ferry only.
meta.placeholderNotice: PLACEHOLDER CONTENT. Open Bracket is a fictional event. Names, times, prices, and ferry details on this page are draft copy and have not been verified.

hero.kicker: Two days. One island. Open field.
hero.sub: Day 1 anyone registered can compete in open qualifier heats. Day 2 the top qualifiers play the finals alongside invited creators, in front of a live crowd and on the stream.

about.heading: Not a watch party. A bracket.
paragraphs: [PLACEHOLDER] Open Bracket is a two-day outdoor games festival built around one idea: the audience plays. Most creator events put the talent on a stage and the crowd behind a barrier. Here, anyone with a competitor ticket can enter the Day 1 qualifier heats.

[PLACEHOLDER] Qualifier winners carry their points into Day 2, where they play the finals next to invited online creators. Everything on Day 2 is played in front of a live crowd on the Parade Ground and streamed live.
[PLACEHOLDER] The games are physical, silly, and short. Relay races, target throws, a giant-grid puzzle, a tug of war. No experience needed and no gear to bring.

schedule.heading: Order of play
schedule.note: All times Eastern (ET). [PLACEHOLDER] Times are draft and subject to change. Heat assignments are sent by email 48 hours before Day 1.

days.label: Day 01
days.title: Open Qualifiers
days.summary: Every registered competitor plays three heats across different games. Top 32 on points advance.

sessions.title: Check-in opens
sessions.detail: Wristband pickup at the Soissons Landing check-in tent. First ferries arrive 9:00 AM.

sessions.title: Opening call
sessions.detail: Rules briefing and heat board reveal on the Parade Ground main stage.

sessions.title: Heats 01-04
sessions.detail: Relay Dash, Ring Toss Gauntlet, Grid Lock, and Sack Sprint run in parallel.

sessions.title: Heats 05-08
sessions.detail: Competitors rotate to their second game. Check your wristband color.

sessions.title: Lunch break
sessions.detail: Food trucks on Colonels Row. Water refill stations at every field.

sessions.title: Heats 09-12
sessions.detail: Final qualifier round. Last chance to score points.

sessions.title: Top 32 announced
sessions.detail: Finalists called on the main stage and posted to the heat board and site.

sessions.title: Open play
sessions.detail: All game stations open for practice. No points.

days.label: Day 02
days.title: Finals
days.summary: Top 32 qualifiers play alongside 16 invited creators. Live crowd, live stream, single elimination.

sessions.title: Gates and check-in
sessions.detail: Finalists check in at the green tent by 10:30. Spectators head straight to the Parade Ground.

sessions.title: Stream goes live
sessions.detail: Pre-show, creator intros, and the full bracket draw.

sessions.title: Round of 48
sessions.detail: Mixed teams of qualifiers and creators. Four games, back to back.

sessions.title: Midday break
sessions.detail: Creator meet-and-greet line opens at the merch tent.

sessions.title: Quarterfinals
sessions.detail: Last 8 teams. Crowd vote picks one wildcard game.

sessions.title: Semifinals
sessions.detail: Last 4 teams. Tug of war decides any tie.

sessions.title: Grand final
sessions.detail: One game, chosen by the finalists. Trophy on the main stage.

sessions.title: Close and ferry call
sessions.detail: Staggered exit to the ferries. Listen for your landing.

games.heading: The games
games.intro: [PLACEHOLDER] Eight games. Short rounds, simple rules, built to be played by anyone and watched by everyone.

items.name: Relay Dash
items.desc: Four-leg shuttle relay across the Parade Ground. One baton, one wrong turn allowed.

items.name: Ring Toss Gauntlet
items.desc: Ten rings, five posts, rising distance. Points for accuracy, bonus for a clean sweep.

items.name: Grid Lock
items.desc: A giant floor-tile puzzle. One partner reads the pattern, the other moves the tiles.

items.name: Sack Sprint
items.desc: Burlap sacks, a straight lane, and a finish line. Exactly what it sounds like.

items.name: Bucket Brigade
items.desc: Move water from one barrel to another with cups. Most water wins. You will get wet.

items.name: Target Kick
items.desc: Soccer ball, painted target wall, five attempts. Center ring scores triple.

items.name: Memory Board
items.desc: Flip giant cards and match pairs against the clock. The crowd is not allowed to help. The crowd will help.

items.name: Tug of War
items.desc: The tiebreaker and the Day 2 showpiece. Rope, chalk line, no gloves.

creators.heading: Creator lineup
creators.intro: [PLACEHOLDER] Sixteen invited online creators join the finals on Day 2. All names below are fictional placeholders.

logistics.heading: Getting there
logistics.intro: Governors Island is car-free and reachable only by ferry. Plan your trip to the landing, not to the island. [PLACEHOLDER] Ferry details below are draft and must be verified against the operator schedule before publishing.

routes.subway: 1 to South Ferry, R/W to Whitehall St, or 4/5 to Bowling Green. 3-5 min walk.
2/3/4/5 to Borough Hall or R to Court St. 15 min walk.
routes.ferry: Every 30 min on event days. About 10 min crossing.

logistics.lastFerryWarning: Last boats back: 6:00 PM to Brooklyn, 6:30 PM to Manhattan. If you miss them there is no other way off the island. [PLACEHOLDER]

cards.title: Check-in on arrival
cards.body: Walk straight from the ferry to the check-in tent at Soissons Landing. Show the QR code from your confirmation email and get your wristband. Competitors: wristband color is your heat group. Spectators: no check-in needed on Day 1.

cards.title: What to bring
cards.body: Closed-toe shoes you can run in. A change of socks (Bucket Brigade). Sunscreen and a hat. A layer for the ferry, it is always colder on the water. Your phone, charged.

cards.title: Water and shade
cards.body: Free water refill stations at every game field and the main stage. Bring a refillable bottle. Shade tents along Colonels Row. Medical tent next to check-in.

cards.title: Bag policy
cards.body: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 in, or small clutches up to 5.5 x 8.5 in. Bags are checked at the landing. No coolers, glass, or drones. [PLACEHOLDER]

cards.title: Accessibility
cards.body: All ferries and island paths are step-free. Accessible viewing platform at the main stage. Tell us your needs on the registration form and we will plan with you. [PLACEHOLDER]

cards.title: Bikes and getting around
cards.body: The event site is a 5 min walk from either landing. Bike rentals are available on the island. There are no cars, taxis, or rideshare.

watch.heading: Watch from anywhere
watch.intro: [PLACEHOLDER] Day 2 finals stream live from 11:00 ET. Day 1 highlights post throughout the day.

channels.name: Main stream
channels.detail: Full Day 2 broadcast with commentary. Link goes live on this page at 11:00 ET Sunday. [PLACEHOLDER]

channels.name: Field cams
channels.detail: Unedited feeds from each game field on Day 1. Find your friends mid-heat. [PLACEHOLDER]

channels.name: Replays
channels.detail: Full VOD and per-game clips posted within 24 hours of each day. [PLACEHOLDER]

watch.vote: Remote viewers vote for the Day 2 wildcard game in chat during the quarterfinals.

registration.heading: Register
registration.intro: Pick your ticket. Competitors play Day 1 heats and can watch Day 2. Spectators watch either or both days. [PLACEHOLDER] Pricing is draft.
registration.demoNotice: Demo form. Nothing is sent anywhere. Your registration is saved only in this browser (localStorage).

types.label: Competitor
types.desc: Play three qualifier heats on Day 1. Top 32 advance to the finals. Includes Day 2 entry.

types.label: Spectator
types.desc: Watch the heats, the finals, or both. Crowd access to the Parade Ground.

items.q: Do I need to be good at games to compete?
items.a: No. The games are short and simple on purpose. Most people have never played them before. [PLACEHOLDER]

items.q: Can I pick which heats I play?
items.a: Heats are assigned so everyone plays three different games. Your assignments arrive by email 48 hours before Day 1.
Light rain, we play. Lightning or high wind, we pause and post updates on this page and by text. Full cancellation policy: [PLACEHOLDER].

items.q: Is the ferry included in my ticket?
items.a: No. Ferry fare is paid separately to the ferry operator. [PLACEHOLDER] Confirm current fares before publishing.

items.q: What if I miss the last ferry?
items.a: There is no other way off the island, so please do not. Staff start the ferry call 45 minutes before the last boat.
Spectators of all ages are welcome. Competitors must be 16 or older; under 18 needs a guardian on site. [PLACEHOLDER]

items.q: I registered as a spectator. Can I switch to competitor?
items.a: Yes, until competitor spots sell out. Register again with the same email and we will update your ticket. [PLACEHOLDER]
